sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Airport Bonded In-Flight Meal Production and Direct Ramp Delivery

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (offshore International Company regime administered in Apia)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law and equity, as modified by Samoan statute; customary law applies only to land and chiefly titles)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between Samoa and the People's Republic of China for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (SAM–PRC BIT, in force); extension to International Companies is addressed in the entity-level investment protection analysis
Double Taxation Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand (including Tokelau), in force; limited practical application because International Companies are tax-exempt in Samoa
Double Taxation Arrangement between Samoa and Australia, in force; limited practical application to tax-exempt International Companies
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus), in force for Samoa since 2020; relevant to regional airport catering supply chains and trade-in-goods facilitation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) — governs incorporation, name regulation, registered agent and registered office, and beneficial-ownership record-keeping for International Companies; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019 (as amended), together with the Central Bank of Samoa AML/CFT Rules and Financial Intelligence Unit Guidelines — imposes customer due diligence, UBO identification at the 25% ownership/control threshold, and PEP and sanctions screening; the Beneficial Ownership Return and UBO-register regime is administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and the Registrar of International Companies. Nominee arrangements remain structurally available but are transparent to the Registrar, the FIU and the Central Bank; the register is not publicly searchable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity document of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing state authorities (e.g., HKSAR Immigration Department, PRC Public Security Bureau, US Department of State, or equivalent) as verified by a notary public in the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for issuers in Apostille member states; for mainland PRC documents, apostille issued by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs or a provincial Foreign Affairs Office under the PRC accession effective 7 November 2023

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certificate of identity and good standing (UBO personal declaration and AML/CFT due diligence form for each natural person UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Samoan licensed registered agent or a notary public in the foreign jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille in the issuing jurisdiction; where the notary sits outside an Apostille member state, full consular legalization through the local competent ministry and the nearest Samoan consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds confirmation for the initial USD aviation-contract wire funding
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated financial institution holding the UBO's transactional account (e.g., a Hong Kong SAR licensed bank, a PRC bank, or a Samoan qualified bank)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the notarized banker's signature where the banking jurisdiction is an Apostille member state; otherwise consular legalization at the nearest Samoan embassy, high commission or consulate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, signatories and commercial counterparties against the following lists: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) the Samoa Central Bank and Financial Intelligence Unit domestic designations; (iii) OFAC SDN and sectoral listings, which are contractually required because USD aviation-contract wires clear through US correspondent banks; and (iv) Pacific-region targeted sanctions lists administered by Australia and New Zealand as regional best practice. Foreign, domestic and international-organization PEPs, their family members and close associates trigger enhanced due diligence, written source-of-wealth review, 25% ultimate ownership tracing, and escalation to the registered agent's Money Laundering Reporting Officer prior to incorporation. Any confirmed adverse match results in automatic refusal or suspension of the incorporation file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — International Companies Registry electronic filing channel, accessed exclusively through SIFA-licensed registered agents; physical registry: Registrar of International Companies, Apia, Samoa; official information gateway: www.sifa.ws
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal corporate name must be in English and Latin script, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must end with Limited or the permitted abbreviation. Samoan diacritics are accepted but not required. A non-Latin name, such as a Chinese commercial name, is recorded only as a registered translation or trading name in the agent's internal records and in the UBO compliance file; it does not form part of the cleared registry name and parallel trademark registration is recommended.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Government, State, Ministry, Authority, Crown, National — where the proposed name implies Samoan government sponsorship, ministerial prior consent is mandatory
Samoa, Samoan or the Samoan tricolor name elements as the leading or sole name element — consent of the Government of Samoa is mandatory

Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Building Society, Credit Union, Deposit, Custodian, Fund, Mutual Fund — reserved for entities licensed by the Central Bank of Samoa or the Samoa International Finance Authority

Airline, Aviation, Airways, Airport — consent of the Samoa Civil Aviation Authority or the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure is required if the name implies licensed air-transport operation; purely descriptive Inflight Catering or Flight Kitchen names are not restricted
Chamber of Commerce, Red Cross, University, Police, Board of — protected under separate legislation and unavailable without sponsor consent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar refuses a proposed name, the licensed registered agent files a written reconsideration request within 14 calendar days, attaching all required ministerial consents (e.g., civil aviation consent). If the refusal is upheld, a formal appeal may be lodged with the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the reconsideration decision; the Minister's final determination is subject to judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa. The name reservation remains valid for 30 days from clearance and may be renewed for successive 30-day periods by filing a renewal before expiry. A lapsed reservation requires a fresh name application, and the applicant may immediately re-file a corrected name for parallel reservation while an appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual-office mailbox is not permissible as the statutory registered office: every International Company must maintain a physical registered office at the Apia street address of a SIFA-licensed registered agent. The operational inflight-catering kitchen and ramp-delivery base will be located in the host airport jurisdiction under that state's aviation-food and airport licenses and is fully distinct from the Samoan registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 5% to 10% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection of the Apia registered office by the Registrar or the Financial Intelligence Unit; the airport kitchen is outside Samoa's inspection perimeter and will instead face mandatory unannounced hygiene and food-safety audits by the host-state airport health authority.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Regulatory name clearance and 30-day name reservation, including initial name-search certificate
Certificate of Incorporation and first-year government registration fee for an International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations, as applied

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year International Company annual government maintenance fee
Licensed registered agent and Apia registered office — year-one retainer
AML/CFT client due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening, and establishment of the regulatory UBO register (up to 3 UBOs)
Drafting of articles of association, incorporation application, director and shareholder consents, and corporate governance file
Notarization and apostille bundle for UBO identity instruments and bank reference letter (4 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-jurisdiction notary public and competent apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary and apostille tariffs plus disbursements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation of Chinese-language identity and source-of-funds documents, plus Pinyin transliteration certificate
E-filing courier, banking protocol documents, and incidental registry disbursements

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 4 (incorporation), 6 (name), 9 (registered office and agent), 23 (share capital), 45 (board of directors); International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2009.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1) together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association; the resultant statutory instrument is the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; share capital may be denominated in any currency; no escrow or paid-up deposit obligation exists under s. 23 of the International Companies Act 1987. The subscriber must subscribe to at least one share, but payment may be deferred as provided in the Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Incorporation Application filed with the Samoa International Companies Registry be and is hereby ratified and confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER that the subscriber's allotment of ordinary shares in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of Association be and is hereby approved and the share register opened. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office situated at the address designated by the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, be and is hereby adopted as the company's registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER that the persons named in the register be and are hereby appointed Sole Director, Secretary, and President, each to serve until their successors are duly appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER that the officers be and are hereby authorized to open bank accounts and execute all operational contracts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, MCIL (application submitted through a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-0 Name Reservation Request through a licensed international company registered agent. The proposed name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', or an approved abbreviation, and must not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered name. The Registry reserves an approved name for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Form IC-0 Name Reservation Request
Certified copy of director or beneficial owner passport
Registered agent engagement letter
Authorization letter for name search
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit alternative names or request a statutory review by the Registrar within 14 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Samoa) and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act 1987 and the prescribed schedule form; the subscriber executes the document before a notary public; the registered agent certifies its consent to act as registered agent.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notarized subscriber signature pages
Consent of registered agent to act
Certified passport copies and proof of residential address of subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries any clause, file an amendment of the constitutional documents, obtain the Registrar's ruling, and re-notarize the corrected pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing and Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association, and pay the prescribed government filing fee of USD 100. The Registry examines the application for statutory compliance before issuing the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Registered agent certificate
Government fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Registrar's requisition letter within 21 days, correct the deficiencies, and refile. An expedited processing request may be submitted where operational delay causes demonstrated prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Register Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number and date of incorporation, and enters the company in the International Companies Register. The company acquires juridical personality on the date stated in the certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Extract of International Companies Register entry
Certificate of registered office and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request administrative rectification under s. 114 of the International Companies Act 1987 for any clerical error appearing on the certificate or in the register entry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Corporate Governance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (or unanimous written resolution of directors)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the pro forma First Board Resolution, allot the subscribed ordinary shares, appoint the Sole Director, Secretary, and President, adopt the registered office, open the share register and minute book, and issue share certificates to members.
required_dossiers: Pro forma First Board Resolution
Unanimous written consent in lieu of meeting
Share certificates and register of members
Officer consent forms and statutory declarations of fitness
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If board quorum cannot be convened, pass a unanimous written resolution in lieu of a meeting as permitted under s. 45 of the International Companies Act 1987.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax, Food Safety, and Environmental Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Samoa), Ministry of Health Food Control Unit, and Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the International Company Tax Exemption Certificate, register the catering premises with the Ministry of Health and obtain a Food Business Operator Permit, secure environmental authorization from MNRE, and register under customs bonded procedures if receiving duty-free airline provisions and operating direct ramp delivery.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Tax exemption application form
Lease agreement and floor plan of the catering kitchen
Food business operator application and menu specification
Environmental authorization application and site assessment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a permit or clearance is refused, appeal to the relevant Minister within 30 days, or remedy the inspection deficiencies cited and reapply for the authorization.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health, Food Control Unit, acting jointly with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) for manufacturing premises clearance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Operator Permit (Food Act 2015 and Food Hygiene Regulations 2011) for Airport Bonded In-Flight Meal Production and Direct Ramp Delivery

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) – Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 development requiring a Registration-level Environmental Assessment and environmental authorization under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater pre-treatment with grease traps to meet Samoa national effluent standards (BOD ≤ 20 mg/L, COD ≤ 60 mg/L, TSS ≤ 30 mg/L), VOC and odour containment within workplace limits, and mandatory segregation and licensed disposal of food waste under the Water Resources Management Act 2008 and national waste management codes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA); structural load inspection and building code compliance certificate from PUMA Building Control; and occupational workplace clearance from MCIL Occupational Safety and Health Administration covering ventilation, food handling hygiene, and emergency evacuation protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa, combining the Inland Revenue Division and Samoa Customs; official taxpayer portal at www.revenue.gov.ws.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity not operating as an exempt International Company must first complete business registration with the Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour through the Companies Office, then submit the Ministry for Revenue Taxpayer Registration form (paper at the Apia office or via the MfR e-services portal) together with: certified certificate of incorporation or equivalent, constitution, registered-office certificate, identification of directors/shareholders, and notarized power of attorney for the Samoan representative. The MfR then issues a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and, where taxable activity has Samoan nexus, a Value Added Goods and Services Tax registration certificate. An exempt International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 may obtain an administrative TIN through the same non-resident channel, but it is not required to file income tax or VAGST returns for exempt offshore operations and no VAGST registration is required for zero-rated export-only supplies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: An International Company may, by special resolution filed with the Registrar of International Companies, elect to convert into an ordinary local company, thereby voluntarily subjecting itself to income tax at the standard corporate rate (27%) and to the standard VAGST regime. Samoa does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime; entity classification is governed by the International Companies Act 1987 and the Income Tax Act 2012. No separate hybrid-mismatch election is available; Samoa's BEPS-aligned rules treat exempt International Companies as non-resident for treaty and controlled-foreign-company analysis.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of taxable supplies made in Samoa over any consecutive 12-month period; optional registration permitted for lower-turnover exporters
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, SAF-T filing, or digital stamping mandate exists in Samoa. Registered suppliers must issue paper or electronic VAGST tax invoices containing the supplier name, address and TIN, sequential invoice number, date, description of supplies, the zero-rated and 15% split, and the amount of tax charged. Customs export entries are filed electronically through the Samoa Customs ASYCUDA World system, which serves as the fiscal clearance reference for export zero-rating.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically removed from Samoa as export cargo, and supplies made directly for the operation or maintenance of international aircraft, including bonded in-flight meals delivered to the airline ramp at the airport, qualify for zero-rating. The supplier must hold documentary evidence of physical exportation, of the non-resident recipient's status, and must satisfy the Ministry for Revenue that the goods were not supplied to a Samoan resident for consumption in Samoa. Excess input VAGST attributable to zero-rated export supplies is refundable, subject to documentary substantiation and the statutory refund process.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs electronic export declaration (ASYCUDA World export entry) covering the HS in-flight catering product classification
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Bill of lading or airway bill evidencing physical exportation from Samoa
Inward remittance certificate or bank statement evidencing foreign-currency receipt from the airline counterparty
Certificate of origin, if required in the airline's import jurisdiction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may audit export zero-rating claims for up to seven years from the end of the relevant tax period. A shortfall penalty of up to 100% of the unpaid tax, daily late-payment penalties, and retrospective reassessment at 15% apply to unjustified or inadequately documented zero-rating. Fraudulent claims expose the entity to clawback of refunds, cancellation of VAGST registration, monetary penalties, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion under the Tax Administration Act 2019 and the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992, with imprisonment terms for individuals involved in deliberate evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Falefa, Apia, established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984; foreign exchange is administered via the Exchange Control Regulations 1984 and the Financial Institutions Act 2005. All cross-border payment and FX transactions must be routed through a licensed authorized dealer. Accounts for non-resident International Companies require explicit CBS permission for foreign-currency retention and outward remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) operates under a non-fully-convertible, administratively controlled regime. Current-account payments, including trade settlements, freight, fuel, catering raw-material imports, and demonstrable service fees, are routinely approved with documented underlying contracts and tax clearance. Profit and dividend remittances by a tax-exempt International Company are allowable only where audited profits, substance evidence, and the registered agent's good-standing certificate are presented; capital-account transactions (equity injection, shareholder loans, capital repatriation, and any pledge of local assets) require prior CBS approval on a case-by-case basis. In practice, foreign-currency accounts (USD, EUR, AUD, NZD) may be held only with CBS consent, and WST is fully convertible for approved trade payments but not freely available offshore.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must receive export proceeds within 3 months from the date of export and must immediately offer the foreign currency to an authorized dealer. Bonded in-flight catering deliveries to airline operators are treated as export-like supplies requiring the operator to obtain a CBS 'retention of export proceeds' consent so that USD-denominated airline invoices may be retained in a designated foreign-currency operating account; any non-approved balance must be converted into WST within the statutory period. Failure to comply triggers exchange-control penalties and freezing of banking facilities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational WST/USD Account; Capital Escrow Account upon CBS approval
Operational USD/WST Account; Escrow Account (transitional ownership risk)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa has no dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) or digital banking licensing regime; the CBS licenses only commercial banks and licensed money-remittance businesses under the Financial Institutions Act 2005. An offshore digital EMI cannot act as the primary treasury account holder in Samoa and should be used only as an upstream collection vehicle outside Samoa; all settlement, payroll, and FX execution must pass through a tier-1 authorized dealer bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance or bank-certified introduction is effectively mandatory. Non-resident directors and beneficial owners of an International Company must appear in person at the Samoa bank, or complete a certified 'introduction and verification' via a Samoan licensed trust company / registered agent, with notarized passport and address verification. Fully remote video onboarding is not accepted by tier-1 banks for non-resident principal structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer or opaque beneficial owner structure; nominee discretion not supported by documentary evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent's due-diligence certificate for the Samoa International Company; current registry extract from the Samoa Registrar of International Companies; trust deed and letter of wishes; ultimate beneficial owner declaration; CRS/FATCA registration and tax self-certification forms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Director or shareholder residing in a high-risk or sanctions-affected jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions and regulatory database screening report; notarized passport copies; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; two bank/trade references; execution copy of airline catering contract and board resolution appointing the bank relationship manager.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company perceived as a shell with no commercial substance in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bonded kitchen operating licence issued by the Ministry of Health; airport security/ramp access permit; premises lease agreement; local staffing and payroll records; aircraft catering purchase orders; CBS approval for bonded export operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ISIC 5621 catering activity paired with monthly ACH-style payroll rails not existing in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Local payroll administration agreement with a Samoa-based payroll provider; monthly settlement via local automated clearing and SWIFT MT103 for expatriate employees; social security (Samoa National Provident Fund) contribution statements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity and shareholder-loan injections must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 from the family trust or corporate parent with the instruction 'capital contribution to International Company' or 'shareholder loan', accompanied by CBS foreign-investment approval where the threshold applies, CRS/FATCA declarations, and the registered agent's KYC confirmation. Cash shipments, personal-account layering, and third-party benefit transfers are prohibited. The bank will require the source of funds to be tax-clean and consistent with the trust deed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments and intercompany invoices are settled by SWIFT MT103 with full purpose-code references and underlying contracts. Aviation-grade raw-material imports should use documentary commercial letters of credit (confirmed or unconfirmed) issued by the Samoa authorized dealer and advised through a major correspondent bank. Airline monthly invoices are cleared by USD wire referencing the airline contract and CBS retention approval. ACH is unavailable in Samoa; monthly recurring payments must be executed as repeated MT103 instructions or through the local Samoan automated clearing system for WST payroll and domestic vendors.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Transaction-backed forward foreign-exchange contracts (typically up to 12 months) with a licensed authorized dealer bank
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) on WST arranged through an international correspondent bank where real-delivery WST cannot be settled
FX swaps and rolling spot conversions with authorized dealers for periodic trade settlement
Cross-currency swaps between USD and WST for large catering contracts, subject to case-by-case CBS approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee Renewal for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date of incorporation; filing and payment due no later than the last day of the month following the anniversary month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of 10% of the annual government fee assessed after the due date; continued non-payment for 3 months may result in administrative strike-off and loss of legal capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of Directors, Members, and Registered Office (Form IC-AR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour / SIFA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due within 30 days after each annual general meeting, but no later than 15 months after the previous annual return date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalty per month of late filing capped at the Registrar's discretion; persistent default may trigger deregistration or court-imposed compliance order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Inflight Catering Facility Operating License (Food Safety / Airport Permit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Health / Samoa Airport Authority / Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar year renewal by 31 December; new annual permit effective 1 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of catering operations and ramp access; daily penalty may apply for operating without a valid food handling or airport permit.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit not required for a Samoa International Company unless consolidated group turnover exceeds SAT 2,000,000 (approx. USD 730,000) or the articles/registered agent require an audit; otherwise independent audit is elective.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Samoa International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by Samoa; small entities may apply Simplified Accounting Standards under the Samoa International Companies Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of ultimate beneficial ownership is required to be lodged with the registered agent; any change in shareholding or beneficial ownership must be updated in the internal beneficial ownership register and, where applicable, disclosed to the Financial Intelligence Unit under Samoa AML/CFT Rules. No public UBO filing is required for a standard International Company.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 3,000 for a small catering entity; up to USD 5,000 if consolidated group audit required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a valid Samoa International Company (statutory exemption under International Companies Act 1987 (ICA 1987) s.183); standard resident corporate headline rate is 27% under the Income Tax Act 2014 (Samoa)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total income tax exemption for a non-resident IC on foreign-source income and assets, including distributions; no capital gains tax, no gift duty, no stamp duty on IC shares; no withholding obligation on IC distributions to non-residents; exemption is conditioned on the IC not carrying on business in Samoa other than under licence and not deriving Samoa-source income

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Compliance Declaration (Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; filed via the Samoa LTA / Registry e-Portal under ICA 1987 s.93)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months of each anniversary of incorporation; the annual government fee is due and payable with the declaration

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC registered number, exact legal name, and date of incorporation as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident IC must quote its registered agent and confirm the registered office in Samoa; a foreign mailing address is permissible but must be stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC has not carried on any business in Samoa or with Samoa residents during the year, or, if licensed, the licence number and scope of authorised activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an inflight catering kitchen physically operating at Faleolo Airport, the catering supply contract with airlines must be made on an export-service basis; production for local ground consumption must be declared and may jeopardise the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Endorsement by the licensed Samoa resident agent confirming maintenance of the IC's registered office and statutory records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner must ensure the agent is paid and that the agent's annual endorsement is not withheld.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule of every beneficial owner, director, and shareholder holding 10% or more, with identity documents, per the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) filing requirements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Executed in English; the foreign shareholder must provide notarised passport copies and proof of address; changes must be filed within 10 business days.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attract a penalty of WS$200 per calendar month of default per the ICA Regulations; persistent default results in automatic strike-off and deregistration, after which the company cannot be restored for 5 years and the former director/agent become jointly liable for outstanding annual fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Income Tax Return - Companies (Form IRTC); filed electronically through the Samoa Inland Revenue Service (SIRS) e-Services portal of the Ministry of Revenue
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and any final payment are due on the last day of the 6th month after the balance date (standard corporate balance date 31 December; due 30 June following year-end); no automatic extension for non-residents

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source income of the IC and all income derived by the IC as an international company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A valid IC must show zero taxable income here and attach a copy of the ICA 1987 s.183 exemption status; a nil return is still required where any Samoa-source income is declared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue derived from catering production and ramp delivery physically performed in Samoa, including sales to airlines on international routes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any amount is entered, the 27% corporate rate applies to the net income of the Samoa kitchen operation; the IC exemption is automatically compromised for that income year, and the IC must licence the local activity under ICA 1987.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for raw food, kitchen labour, airport concession fees, utilities, maintenance, and arm's-length management fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party catering head-office or procurement fees are deductible only if supported by transfer pricing documentation; head-office expenses are capped at 40% of accounting profit before such allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses applied against current-year taxable income, subject to the 5-year cap and the continuity-of-ownership test.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident controllers must prove that more than 50% of issued shares were continuously beneficially held during the loss year and the utilisation year.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late return: WS$500 flat penalty plus 10% of the tax assessed; late payment: 10% late-payment surcharge plus 2% monthly interest on the unpaid amount; the Commissioner may issue a departure prohibition order to prevent directors from leaving Samoa while tax remains unpaid.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends and other distributions paid by a valid International Company to non-residents (ICA 1987 s.183(2); no duty to withhold); 15% final withholding tax applies only where a domestic Samoa company distributes dividends to non-residents under the Income Tax Act 2014
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa's tax treaty network is limited: a full double tax agreement with the People's Republic of China (dividends 15% / 15%, interest 10%, royalties 10%) and tax information-exchange arrangements (TIEA) with New Zealand and certain Pacific states; to invoke relief the non-resident beneficial owner must: (1) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the home revenue authority; (2) submit IRD Samoa 'Claim for Treaty Relief' form (Form DTA-1) with the agreement, invoice, and TRC at or before the date of repatriation; (3) obtain IRD confirmation of the reduced withholding rate before the distribution is wired, since a refund rather than exemption applies if approval is granted after payment; (4) retain the treaty relief certificate for 7 years
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates for payments to non-residents made by a domestic Samoa company: 15% for interest and 15% for royalties; under the Samoa-China DTA, treaty rates of 10% for interest and 10% for royalties apply subject to TRC and beneficial-ownership certification; payments made by an exempt IC are outside the Samoa WHT net entirely

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Local File / Master File monetary threshold exists under Samoa law; the Income Tax Act 2014 applies the arm's-length principle to all related-party cross-border transactions, and the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 requires all ICs to maintain substance records irrespective of value; as best practice, contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation should be prepared where annual related-party catering procurement, management, or royalty flows exceed WS$1,000,000 per annum, given the high audit risk of airport-located taxpayers
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Samoa, having removed its preferential IC regime from OECD scrutiny, enacted economic substance rules through the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 and ICA 1987 ss.13A-13D. An IC deriving income from a 'relevant activity', which includes provision of services such as airline inflight catering, must in any income year: (i) be managed and controlled in Samoa (board meetings held and minutes kept in Samoa); (ii) maintain adequate physical premises, a resident workforce, and operating expenditure in Samoa proportionate to the catering activity; and (iii) carry on core income-generating activities (food production and ramp logistics) in Samoa. A confidential economic substance declaration must be filed annually with the Registrar; failure leads to penalty, reclassification, or deregistration, and the revenue authority may upwardly adjust profits at the 27% rate.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly recording international airline catering revenue as exempt foreign-source income of the IC while the kitchen physically operates in Samoa, or destroying kitchen production records to understate taxable turnover.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment at 27% on the full concealed profit plus an evasion penalty of up to 200% of the tax shortfall and interest at 2% per month; criminal prosecution may result in a fine of up to WS$100,000 and imprisonment of up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and the registered agent are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax where they directed or assisted the concealment; the court may impose a departure prohibition order, freeze personal bank accounts, and sentence directors to custodial terms; a conviction additionally disqualifies the director from managing any Samoa company for 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a letterbox entity that invoices related-party inflight catering fees without any real kitchen, staff, management, or core decision-making in Samoa, thereby misrepresenting the economic substance declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalty of up to WS$100,000 per relevant activity year; the Commissioner may reclassify the IC as a resident taxpayer, taxing worldwide income at 27% with no allowance for the IC exemption; the Registrar may cancel the Certificate of Incorporation and publish the name of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the re-assessed corporate tax where the substance declaration was knowingly false; the court may strike the director from the Samoa Register of Directors for 3 years, issue a travel ban, and order restitution of profits extracted as management fees within the look-back period.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to disclose ultimate beneficial ownership of the airborne catering joint venture, filing false passport data for the non-resident shareholder, or allowing cash payments for catering to be routed through personal accounts to avoid the AML/CFT Act 2018 reporting threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory penalties under the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU): up to WS$100,000 for the entity and WS$25,000 for the licensed agent per violation; the FIU may suspend the IC's bank accounts and file a suspicious transaction report; criminal conviction can attract up to 5 years' imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face personal fines, asset freezing orders, and, where money laundering is proven, imprisonment; the registered agent's licence may be revoked for enabling the concealment, and the IC is compulsorily wound up with directors bearing the costs.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlawful Local Business Operation (Exceeding IC Licence Scope)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the inflight catering kitchen at Faleolo International Airport without a valid business licence issued by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, or selling prepared meals to domestic airlines and airport retail counters beyond the export-service licence scope.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to WS$50,000 under ICA 1987 and a cease-and-desist order; each month of unlicensed operation is a separate offence; the Commissioner may additionally withdraw the IC's tax exemption and assess all catering revenue at 27% as Samoa-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly trade without the licence are personally liable for the unpaid annual government fees, licence penalties, and strike-off costs; the Minister may petition the court for 5-year disqualification of directors from holding any ICA company office and seek enforcement of the penalty against personal assets.
